newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Duracell busy pre-merger.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Duracell busy pre-merger.

text.p: Few Duracell International Inc options made actives lists over the past several days, but traders said some investors were moving relatively heavily into them ahead of news of a merger with Gillette Co.
Duracell options trade on the American Stock Exchange (AMEX), New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and the Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX), but the bulk is done on the AMEX.

"I heard there was a lot of hot buying in the last couple of days in front of the takeover," said one trader on the AMEX floor. "The pricing on the options could be suspicious as far as insider trading goes."

On Tuesday, 1,768 of the Duracell September 50 calls traded. "That doesn't sound like much, but put it this way -- there were close to 20 days when the volume was zero," said Harrison Roth, a first vice president at Cowen & Co.
About 1,700 of the September 50 puts traded by 1230 CDT on the AMEX. The option soared 6-1/2 points to 7-3/4. Through Wednesday, its open interest was 3,309.
Roughly 400 traded on the PHLX and none on the NYSE.
The merger news drove Duracell shares up as much as 10 points. At 1230 CDT (1730 GMT), the stock was up 8-3/4 at 57-7/8. Volume was heavy at more than 6.4 million shares.
Gillette shares were up 3/8 to 65-3/8 after hitting a session low of 63 and a high of 66-7/8. About 5.9 million Gillette shares changed hands.
The AMEX would not say whether it was investigating Duracell options activity.
"Any time there's news out, it's standard procedure to look at the activity surrounding that news," a spokesman said.
Roughly 500 of the Duracell September 50 calls traded on Wednesday, at prices ranging from 7/8 to 1-1/4. On Monday, the option was trading at 3/16.
The September options expire on September 20.
The October 50 calls traded 730 contracts on the AMEX, 50 on the PHLX and 14 on the NYSE. Through Wednesday, its open interest was 873.
On the AMEX, the option was trading up 6-5/16 at 8-1/2 after reaching 9-1/2.
The Duracell September 55 put traded more than 400 contracts on the AMEX on Thursday. The option had zero open interest through Wednesday. It slumped 6-7/8 to 1/4.
The same option traded 300 contracts on the PHLX, where it lost 5-15/16 to 1-3/16.
Other active October options on Duracell included the 60 call and the 50 and 55 puts.
For Gillette, call activity swamped put activity, as only 381 puts traded compared to well over 6,000 calls.
The most active Gillette option was the September 50 call, which traded nearly 2,600 contracts.
With the stock rebounding, the option edged up 1/8 to 15-3/8.
The September 60 call traded about 1,300 contracts, the September 65 1,275 and the October 60 1,440. --G.Crawford, (312) 408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
